x: Our field men got us off to a great start with Terry Welsh 2nd in the hammer and Ken Onuagaluchi beating ex-International John Hillier inthe discus for the first time in a B.A.L. match.

Paul Richley won the junior 1500m and Ken Onuagaluchi clocked up his second win over John Hillier in the discus. All this plus a clean sweep in the 3000m walk gave us victory in the Pepper Trophy which is for senior and junior competitors.
Lee Newman found the form of his life at Crystal Palace, spinning the discus out to 60.48 to break John Hillier's 21 year-old Kent County record of 56.46 and top Abi Ekoku's Belgrave best by 40cm.
